provenance_sources.note: P0 reuses checked-in infrastructure identities only; it does not reuse judged tasks, outcomes, or semantic interventions. After the failed 2c72da1 cohort showed sustained proxy 504s, the pre-existing approved direct/internal Ollama endpoint was selected as an infrastructure-only remediation before any replacement cohort; old cohorts remain unpooled. After the failed 061307a development smoke exhausted 1024 tokens in reasoning-only output, isolated provider qualification against Ollama 0.32.0 showed that the documented reasoning_effort=none setting preserved the required JSON/tag contract at the existing token budget for controller-managed OpenAILanguageModel calls. This provider configuration change requires a new execution revision and is not pooled with prior attempts.

runtime.task_goal: Explore the nearby area using ordinary available tools. Move to a nearby location that your observations support, then report what you did.
Inspect nearby entities and terrain using ordinary tools. Navigate to a location that was exposed by your observations and summarize the result.
Work together to survey the local area. Use normal communication if useful, then move one agent toward a nearby observed entity or point and report completion.
Observe the surroundings, choose a nearby destination justified by what you observed, navigate there through the ordinary agent loop, and report the outcome.
Find something nearby that can be approached safely using your normal observations. Coordinate naturally and navigate toward it before reporting what happened.
Survey nearby entities, exchange information normally if useful, and reposition an agent to a location supported by the survey. Report the final action.
Use the ordinary agent loop to inspect the local environment and make a short movement based on current observations. Do not assume hidden world state; report what you observed and did.
Collaboratively inspect nearby state using ordinary tools, select an observed destination, navigate toward it, and summarize the natural sequence of actions.
